speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help narrow this down, how many fingers is the pain traveling down your leg, and does it get worse when you cough or sneeze?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lumbar Herniated Disc (Radiculopathy).

The history of sudden onset during exercise with sharp pain radiating to the foot is classic for a disc herniation. I will request an MRI to confirm the level and severity of the compression. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI
